commits.author: Loiane Groner
commits.message:
Merge pull request #651 from loiane/loiane/repo-improvement-suggestions

Broaden RFC 7807 error handling for type mismatch and missing params

commits.author: Loiane
commits.message:
feat(errors): return RFC 7807 problem details for type mismatch and missing params

Add ApplicationControllerAdvice handlers for MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException
and MissingServletRequestParameterException so invalid @PathVariable/@RequestParam
values (e.g. non-numeric id or pageSize) and missing required query params return
a consistent RFC 7807 Problem Detail body instead of Spring Boot's default error
format. pageSize was already capped via @Max(1000) on CourseService#findAll.
